label: For "Branch Footfall & Staffing Forecast": Forecast branch visits by hour so rosters match demand and queues stay short. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Closed days in the history look like zero demand and bias the forecast.
